viewSettingSkipTriggers: Skip triggers during skill tests that don't affect the outcome
viewSettingShowOtherPlayersHands: See the cards in other players' hands at all times.
viewSettingSounds: Play sound effects in this browser.
viewSettingExtraAnimations: Decorative effects like burning locations and the Cosmic Emissary beams. Never affects anything you need to see to play.
viewSettingExtraAnimationsReducedMotion: Currently off anyway, because this device asks for reduced motion.
viewSettingExtraAnimationsScenario: Override the setting above for this game only.
viewSettingCosmicEmissary: Shows animated Cosmic Emissary connection effects for Fate of the Vale.
viewSettingAsIfRuling: Swap between Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 handling for "as if" effects during nested window checks. This affects everyone in the game.
fileBugPart1: This will store the current game state, and fill in a GitHub issue. You will need a GitHub account in order to proceed.
fileBugPart2: It should only take a moment to create the bug and you can resume playing once done.
fileBugPart3: The uploaded debug file will only include the last 30 steps so please ensure your issue is within that scope or provide additional information for recreating the issue.
bugTitleholder: A brief title for the bug
bugSubmittingTitle: Submitting bug, this may take several minutes, please wait...
bugSubmittingContent: When this process is done, it will open GitHub in a new window and you will be able to resume your game.
